test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Physical activity has been __projected to be helpful on avoidance__ of depression, by the experts.

options.text: projected to be helpful about avoidance
projected to be helpful in the avoidance
projected to be helpful for avoidance
projected to be helpful of avoidance

solution:
The correct answer is: **'projected to be helpful in the avoidance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate substitute of the given part of the sentence is: **'****projected to be helpful in the avoidance'.**
 
• The error in the underlined part of the sentence is: **'Preposition'.**
 
• So, replacing **'on**' with **'in the'** will make the sentence correct as we use **'in'** to suggest to indicate location or position within or inside something.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

**Correct sentence:**__* Physical activity has been __projected to be helpful i**n the** avoidance__ of depression, by the experts.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'projected to be helpful about avoidance'** is not correct here.
 
• **'projected to be helpful for avoidance' **is not correct here.
 
• **'projected to be helpful of avoidance'** is not correct here.
